Privacy without the fog

What Stay Away From Poison Hotdogs collects, why it is needed, who receives it, and how a parent can delete it.

Last updated: September 11, 2026

On this page Quick summary Who operates the app Data we handle Names and leaderboards Advertising Purchases Service providers Retention and deletion Choices for parents Security Contact

The short version

A child-directed game with limited online services

Stay Away From Poison Hotdogs is made for children about ages 6–8. It has no chat, social messaging, email sign-up, or username-and-password login. It does use an anonymous game record, an optional public leaderboard nickname, Google Play purchases, and one optional rewarded ad.

No account credentials

The game does not ask for an email address, password, phone number, or social login.

Optional nickname

A filtered display name and score can appear on the public leaderboard.

Contextual rewarded ad

The ad is optional, child-directed, general-audience, and not interest-personalized.

Parent controls

Analytics can be turned off and the anonymous player record can be deleted.

We do not sell personal information. Some data is transferred to Microsoft PlayFab, Google AdMob, and Google Play Billing as described below. In this policy, collected includes data sent off the device, and shared includes data transferred to a third-party SDK or service.

Data map

What the game collects or shares

The table below matches the data categories disclosed for the Android app. These items may be retained; they are not limited to momentary in-memory processing.

Data type Status What it means here Why / recipient
Approximate location Collected + shared An IP address may be used to estimate a general area. The app does not request precise GPS location. Advertising, analytics, and fraud prevention through Google AdMob.
Name Collected · optional A generated nickname or a filtered display name chosen for the leaderboard. Do not enter a child's real name. Game functionality through PlayFab. The display name and score may be visible to other players.
User IDs Collected A random installation ID created by the app and the corresponding PlayFab player ID. They are not login credentials. Game functionality, analytics, and fraud prevention through PlayFab.
Purchase history Collected · optional Which game item or content was purchased or unlocked. We do not receive card or bank details. Game functionality, analytics, and fraud prevention through Google Play Billing and PlayFab.
App interactions Collected + shared Interactions such as app or ad activity, taps, launches, and video views. Analytics, advertising, and fraud prevention through AdMob; limited game analytics through PlayFab.
Other actions Collected Gameplay records such as scores, stars, level progress, coin balance, unlocked items, and game events. Game functionality, analytics, and fraud prevention through PlayFab.
Diagnostics Collected + shared SDK and app diagnostic or performance information used to understand failures and service quality. Analytics, advertising measurement, and fraud prevention through AdMob.
Device or other IDs Collected + shared The app-generated random installation ID, PlayFab ID, and identifiers AdMob uses for app or device operations. The Android Advertising ID permission is removed from the app. Game functionality, analytics, advertising, and fraud prevention through PlayFab and AdMob.

Data the game does not request

The game does not request precise location, an email address, a phone number, postal contacts, photos, videos, audio recordings, files, calendar entries, contacts, private messages, health information, fitness information, or web-browsing history. It does not request camera or microphone access.

Anonymous play

Player records, names, and leaderboards

The game creates a random, installation-scoped identifier and uses it to open an anonymous PlayFab player record. It does not use the phone's hardware identifier and does not let a player sign in with an external account.

A player may keep a generated silly nickname or type an optional filtered display name. The display name and high score may appear to other players on the public leaderboard. Parents should tell children to use a nickname and never enter a real full name or other personal details.

Optional ad

Advertising

The game offers one optional rewarded ad after a run: a player may watch it to keep going. Skipping the offer skips the free revive and does not block ordinary play. Google AdMob serves the ad.

  • Ad requests are configured for child-directed treatment.
  • The maximum ad content rating is set to G (general audiences).
  • Ads are non-personalized and are not selected from a child's interest profile.
  • The app removes permission to access the Android Advertising ID.

AdMob still automatically processes information needed to deliver, measure, and protect the ad service, including IP address, app interactions, diagnostics, and device or app identifiers. That is why those categories are disclosed as collected and shared.

Optional shop

In-app purchases

The game can offer optional items or content for purchase. Before Google Play's purchase window opens, the game presents a grown-up gate intended to keep a young child from starting the transaction alone.

Google Play Billing processes payment details. We do not receive a card number or bank information. The game receives transaction status and records the item or entitlement needed to deliver and restore the purchase.

Where data goes

Service providers and sharing

Microsoft PlayFab

Hosts the anonymous player record, leaderboard, scores, progress, virtual inventory, purchase entitlements, and limited game events on our behalf. Microsoft privacy statement

Google AdMob

Delivers the optional contextual rewarded ad and processes ad interactions, approximate location derived from IP, diagnostics, and device or app identifiers for delivery, analytics, and fraud prevention. Google privacy policy

Google Play Billing

Processes optional purchases, payment information, and transaction status. We receive only the purchase information needed to provide the item or content. Google Play terms

We do not sell personal information and do not permit data from the app to be used for behavioral advertising. Providers may retain information under their own legal obligations and published policies.

Your controls

Retention and deletion

Local save data remains on the device until it is deleted in the game, the app's storage is cleared, or the app is uninstalled. The PlayFab player record is kept while needed to provide saved progress, leaderboards, purchases, security, and support, unless a parent requests deletion sooner. Google controls retention for data processed by AdMob and Google Play under Google's policies.

1

In the game
Open the Grown-Ups area and choose Delete My Data.

2

Confirm the request
After server deletion succeeds, the app clears the local save.

3

If you need help
Email gr0sstech.support@gmail.com.

If the in-app deletion reports an error, retry or contact us; the game does not claim success and silently leave the server record behind. If the app is unavailable, email us and include the player nickname and any in-game player ID you have. We may ask for limited additional information to locate the correct anonymous record. We will respond to and complete a verifiable request within 30 days.

For parents

Notice and choices

Before the game starts its online player services for the first time, it shows a grown-up privacy notice and waits for acknowledgment. The Grown-Ups area also lets a parent turn optional game analytics off.

A parent or legal guardian may contact us to:

  • ask what personal information is associated with the child's player record;
  • request a copy or correction where applicable;
  • refuse further collection by disabling optional analytics or stopping use; and
  • request deletion of the player's server record and local save.

We will verify that the requester is authorized before providing or deleting a child's information. We will not require a child to disclose more information than is reasonably necessary to participate in the game.

Safeguards

Security

Data is encrypted in transit using HTTPS/TLS. We limit the data sent by the app, disable PlayFab device-information and focus-time collection, and use a random app identifier instead of a hardware identifier. No system is perfectly secure, but we use reasonable technical and organizational measures appropriate to the data.

Updates

Changes to this policy

If the game's data practices change, we will update this page and its “Last updated” date before the change is released. If a change requires new parental notice or consent, we will provide it before collecting the affected information.
